translations.web: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
translations.bsb: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
translations.kjv: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
